submission.summary: 定位到旧实现用 str.isdigit() 做数字校验，会把全角/其他 Unicode 数字（如１２.３４、上标数字）当作合法并交给 int() 解析，导致畸形金额被接受；同时小数位换算依赖截断拼接、缺少对整数部分为空的显式检查。修复后的 parse_amount_cents 保持签名不变：仅接受 str，只 strip 首尾 ASCII 空白（空格/\t/\r/\n，内部空白仍非法）；按“可选单个 +/- → 可选 ¥/￥ → 非空整数部分 → 可选小数点+1~2位”顺序解析；逗号分组要求首组1~3位、后续恰3位且不得出现在小数部分；改用 all(ch in '0123456789' ...) 强制 ASCII 数字，拒绝指数、下划线、括号、NaN/Inf、Unicode 数字与多余符号；金额全程用整数计算（1位小数×10，2位直接取整，int(digits)*100+frac_cents），不调用 float/round，避免二进制浮点误差；绝对值超过 999999999.99 元抛 ValueError，负零归一为 0。公开测试从 22/24（T012、T019 失败）修复后 24/24 全部通过，且检查确认源码不含 float/round。

code_followup_reason: Original candidate code task took 148.743s vs 129.062s baseline (15.25% slower), concentrated in late decode. Preselected three-run follow-up: candidate, baseline, candidate with router disabled. Original result retained.
performance_interpretation: The 40-request A/B/B/A engine-wire benchmark shows small long-input TTFT improvements, not universal task acceleration. Full tool-task wall times fluctuate; baseline also slowed substantially in follow-up. Background CPU activity was observed, but the root cause was not established. No thermal, power, or system-wide quiet-state control was applied.

reasons: Retain proven correctness fixes and legacy-equivalent wave32 routing without enabling lower-precision defaults.

Reject the unproven arena-layout change and defer arithmetic/checkpoint changes without sufficient evidence.
